description: A realistic small-business site (Meridian Coffee Roasters) that exercises every composition, head-merge, URL, exclusion, and Markdown rule at least once. One deliberate advisory (the void <include> in legal/privacy.html) is declared below; everything else builds clean. The site is coherent on purpose: integration failures that rule-by-rule micro-fixtures miss (include-into-layout head merging, include-authored URL provenance inside a section layout, Markdown under a section layout) all occur here naturally. The menu section uses a complete standalone _layout.html — layout chaining is not part of v0.7.0 (P15).

harnessContract.run: for each profile: unify build -s tests/fixtures/kitchen-sink/src -o <tmp>/dist <flags>
harnessContract.treeComparison: bidirectional against expectedTree using the single harness comparator (tests/conformance/compare.mjs): a file missing from dist or extra in dist fails; HTML files are compared exactly on structure, attributes and their order, comments, and text content, with only whitespace-only text nodes outside pre/textarea/script/style normalized (testing-strategy section 2); non-HTML files byte-exact. This is what makes the never-shipped list (.env), the underscore exclusions, and LAY-12/LAY-13 (no data-layout, no data-polyfill script tag in output) assertions rather than intentions.
harnessContract.diagnostics: stderr is parsed into (file, line?, severity, message) records using the stable prefix contract (conformance spec 14.1). The declared list below is exhaustive per profile: any undeclared diagnostic of either severity fails the run. This enforces the closed problem/advisory catalogue and the advisory discipline on a correct site.
harnessContract.determinism: every profile runs twice; the second run must produce a byte-identical tree and byte-identical stdout/stderr (DIA-05).
harnessContract.publishGate: profiles with published=false pre-seed <tmp>/dist with a sentinel tree and assert it is byte-untouched afterwards (PUB-01).

ruleNotes.INC-03: leading-/ branch only here; the relative branch is FIX-01 (spec 5.2) and landmine include-relative
ruleNotes.URL-01: href/src branches; srcset/poster branches live in landmine srcset-poster-rewrite
ruleNotes.HED-01: branches: page-without-charset (index, about, beans) and identical-charset-silent (contact); the moved-first and differing branches are landmines charset-page-only / charset-differs
ruleNotes.MRG-13: non-empty default branch; the empty-default-keeps-layout-children branch is landmine empty-default-main
ruleNotes.HED-05: replace branch: contact.html declares its own icon, replacing the layout's favicon; the kept-when-page-declares-none branch is FIX-11

ruleNotes.URL-07: moves about/contact/beans/privacy; index.html files and root 404.html stay
ruleNotes.URL-09: mailto (contact), absolute canonical (layout), relative asset in unmoved page (index beans.jpg) all preserved
ruleNotes.REF-02: the reference check must strip the /coffee/ prefix before resolving, or this green build turns red
ruleNotes.og-note: B3 fixed (2026-08-12): section 11.3 now has one scope for both forms, so beans' og:image takes the path prefix like every other root-relative URL and emits /coffee/assets/beans.jpg; twitter:card 'summary' is not root-relative and stays untouched. Absolutization still requires the full-URL form; the non-root-path absolutization trap itself is pinned by landmine base-url-subpath.

ruleNotes.URL-11: index canonical /index.html and beans og:image /assets/beans.jpg gain the full base (origin + path prefix, here the root path /); the layout's absolute canonical and non-URL meta content are untouched. The non-root-path branch of URL-11 is landmine base-url-subpath

ruleNotes.DIA-03: the single advisory flips the exit code under --strict; publish proceeds unchanged (published stays true — --strict never blocks publish)

strict.note: --strict changes the exit code, never what is published (product-spec §4, conformance §14.1): a stray .psd must not cost you a publish. This fixture asserted published:false and was WRONG — the first fixture defect found in the rewrite, and it did real damage: an implementer read it as authority and rewired build.js's publish gate from problems-only to exitCode===0 to satisfy it, believing it was fixing a bug. Exit stays 1 so CI still gates.
